title: Televised remote viewing by Japanese schoolchildren: starfish target
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Televised remote viewing by Japanese schoolchildren: starfish target, about unspecified at Japan (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: school school rooms what the target was was a small aquarium with the starfish

plain: Joe McMoneagle, who practises remote viewing, the attempt to describe a hidden or faraway target using only the mind, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a remote viewing session shown on Japanese television. He says schoolchildren in classrooms in Tokyo, Hokkaido and Kyushu took part, and the hidden target was a small aquarium with a starfish in it. If true, it would suggest that even ordinary children can sense things they cannot see.
